principles: Do not duplicate existing SiteConfig, Studio OS, marketplace, metadata, package, automation, billing, compliance, and runtime systems.
Use /configuration/ as the governed platform configuration facade.
Use tenant school configuration for tenant-scoped setup.
Keep /admin/ compatible and expose /internal-admin/ as technical fallback alias.
Keep external payment and marketplace monetization state external_required until provider evidence exists.

surfaces.tests_needed: existing super HTTP and control-plane boundary tests
configuration center access, module links, tenant blocking

surfaces.risk: blind install without preview, impact analysis, rollback, or audit
surfaces.tests_needed: required blueprint names and preview-only posture

surfaces.risk: package rollout without limits and downgrade posture
surfaces.recommended_action: package library facade linked to rollout governance
surfaces.tests_needed: pack category rendering and non-dummy actions

surfaces.risk: workflow pack without trigger, condition, action, owner, simulation, or deactivation path
surfaces.recommended_action: workflow pack facade with simulation link
surfaces.tests_needed: trigger, condition, action, owner, simulation assertions

surfaces.risk: dashboard pack without role permissions, empty states, or mobile posture
surfaces.recommended_action: dashboard pack facade linked to dashboard registry

surfaces.risk: policy not explainable, auditable, scoped, or reversible
surfaces.recommended_action: policy bundle facade linked to super policy catalog
surfaces.tests_needed: rules, approvals, audit requirements, tenant scope

surfaces.recommended_action: registry center with owner, scope, proof, drift, and route links
surfaces.tests_needed: registry list includes dashboard, workflow, integration, billing, brand, extension, pack, usage, owned models, external dependency

surfaces.risk: tenant sees global registries or platform-only configuration
surfaces.tests_needed: tenant school admin gets 200 and platform global surfaces are absent

surfaces.risk: duplicated admin namespace if mounted twice
surfaces.recommended_action: redirect alias to already split /admin/ mount
surfaces.tests_needed: /admin/ remains compatible; /internal-admin/ resolves on manager and tenant hosts

surfaces.risk: raw CRUD mistaken for product UX
surfaces.recommended_action: keep compatible; use only as technical fallback
